notes.title: Steam Scream Fest 3D - Cards of the Dead is on sale!
notes.content:
[h3]Immerse yourself in a different first-person experience!
[/h3]
FINIS is now on sale at Steam Scream Fest 3D! 🎮 Only until November 4th can you grab this unique game and save 50%!

Enjoy a one-of-a-kind experience: a video game featuring the Lüscher color test. Multiple puzzles and some strange, horrifying environments await you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2103370?utm_source=jandu&utm_campaign=steamscream2024&utm_medium=steamevent
